text:
Maria_CS: Heads-up: Onboarding for merchant 'FinlyPay' - sampling shows 18% drop in embeddings throughput and 2x tail latency on chat endpoint since yesterday. Renewal in 5 weeks. Proactive recs: quantize to int8 on dedicated pool, switch routing to regional fallback, and canary a smaller model (redwood-compact-v1). Thoughts?
Sam_SE: Can you paste the metric window and a sample query?
Maria_CS: Quick snapshot: 95th latency up from 210ms -> 420ms; tokens/sec down ~22%. Traffic: bursts from 8am-10am PST. Avg prompt length ~48 tokens, mostly transactional.
Charlie_Perf: Given short queries, int8 quant + KV prefix cache should help a lot. I can run an A/B canary on Dedicated. Need traffic slice and routing policy.
Leo_Infrastructure: I can provision a 2-node canary in us-east-1 dedicated. ETA ~30m. What traffic slice?
Maria_CS: Start with 5% traffic for 48h. Success criteria: error rate <0.5% and p95 improves by >=20% -> roll to 30%. If any increase in hallucination or regressions flagged by eval set, pause.
Charlie_Perf: Routing config (proposal):
```json
{"route":[{"percent":5,"model":"redwood-compact-v1-int8","region":"us-east-1","fallback":"redwood-base-v2"}],"monitoring":{"p95_threshold_ms":350,"error_rate_threshold":0.5}}
```
Aj_Dev: Re: model swap — ensure tokenizer compat and deterministic sampling settings. Also enforce convo truncation to 512 tokens to keep KV cache effective.
Maria_CS: @Leo please enable KMS access for FinlyPay so we can upload quant artifacts. I will draft a short enablement note for the customer explaining expected improvements and rollback plan.
Leo_Infrastructure: KMS access done. Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-private/finlypay/canary-int8/. Provisioned nodes are up.
deploy-bot: Canary started: 4176543210-canary. Jobs: canary-deploy/4176543210. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/teams/finlypay/canaries/4176543210 :rocket:
Sophie_CS: I'll prep the renewal-facing note summarizing the perf test and timeline, and capture customer feedback at 24h/48h checkpoints.
Maria_CS: Thanks all — I'll update FinlyPay now and schedule the 24h check-in. If anyone spots any anomaly, ping this thread or @eng-oncall.
